# @mdevs/icons

> 2600 distinct minimal SVG geometries on 24px grid, React/TypeScript wrappers, responsive sizing, currentColor, decorative/informative accessibility.

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md)
- [Icon API](catalog/docs/ICONS.md)
- [Icon maintenance](catalog/docs/ICON_MAINTENANCE.md)
- [Detailed agent workflow](catalog/docs/AI_AGENTS.md)
- [Accessibility](catalog/docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md)
- [Machine catalog](catalog/manifest.json)
- [Attribution](NOTICE.md)
- [Document path index](catalog/documentation.json)
- [Consolidated guides](llms-full.txt)
- [Troubleshooting](catalog/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

Search exact manifest names/imports first, then read catalog/<category>/README.md and src/create-icon.tsx. Category guides contain every matching import, raw SVG, source and provenance. Raw SVG public paths omit .svg because exports appends it; importing assets requires host bundler configuration. Native SVG props are spread after defaults and can override dimensions/ARIA. Name the containing button for decorative icons; provide title or an ARIA name for informative graphics. No automatic RTL mirroring or SVGR loader is supplied. Maintenance scripts require the monorepo.

Names use Icon suffix. Copy imports from manifest. Size accepts numbers/em/rem/percentages. Keep LICENSE-LUCIDE and LICENSE-TABLER. Shapes are sourced from Lucide/Tabler, wrapper MIT.

- [Creation/style rules](STYLE.md)
- [0.2 component extension guide](catalog/docs/EXTENSIONS.md)

Approved default: local Inter WOFF2 (UI), subtle 12px glass blur, monochrome black/white icons with 1.5px rounded strokes. Preserve asset licences. New entries must have a real contract and distinct purpose/geometry; sizes/colors/aliases do not count.
